name: Jarvis 29.0
notes: Dealer GOLY Report is now fully dynamic: it uses every financial year in your file and compares the latest year with each earlier year. New Dealer GOLM Report (month-wise): the latest month is compared with every earlier month, plus growth vs previous month. One-tap options: Qty or Value, GOLY or GOLM, Growth % (green) and Degrowth % (red). Warns when the Year column does not match the Invoice Date.
